name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang’s career in motorsport PR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Communications, he initially worked for a local newspaper covering business news. However, a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a charity event sparked his interest in the adrenaline-fueled world of motorsport. He transitioned into the role of media liaison for a small Singaporean racing outfit, quickly proving his knack for crafting compelling narratives and managing crises. 

His approach to PR is rooted in honesty and transparency. He believes that building trust with the media and the public is paramount. He emphasizes building relationships with journalists, leveraging his deep knowledge of motorsport to craft stories that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. His calm demeanor and meticulous planning make him an invaluable asset in the high-pressure environment of racing. What sets Tan apart is his ability to seamlessly blend traditional PR tactics with modern digital strategies, ensuring that Hendrick Motorsports' message reaches a global audience.

After many successes in Asia, Tan Wei Liang decided to challenge himself with a move to NASCAR. Seeing the opportunity to adapt to a new racing culture, he took the challenge and is now a key part of Hendrick Motorsports, bringing with him experience and a unique perspective.
